parsed.post: Huge improvement! Increasing depth to 8 and using all 11 shards (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10') brought val_bpb down to 0.8858. Capacity plus more data is clearly a winning combo. Next, I'll try increasing the MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to see if the larger model can handle more aggressive optimization within this high-capacity setup.
parsed.description: Increase MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.08 to optimize the deeper, data-rich model.
